verdict.rationale: Proa documents its own build-time diagnostics. The template macro validates at compile time, props are compile-time-checked, `--deny warnings` flags performance problems, and WCAG/ARIA checks fail `cargo build` on markup defects. This shows the build tool surfaces problems, but nothing describes the clarity or actionability of the resulting messages, or any dev-server error reporting. missing for 10: evidence of clear or actionable error message content, dev-server error display (overlay or console output on breakage), examples of diagnostics with fix suggestions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get clear, actionable error messages from the dev server and build tool when something breaks

citations.quote: The macro validates the template at compile time
WCAG and WAI-ARIA checks run during cargo build so common markup defects fail before deploy.
`--deny warnings` catches performance problems such as intermediate rendered strings, avoidable allocations, and async renderers that never await
the fields passed to AboutPage are compile-time-checked props.
